novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is primarily a new mechanism and relationship: a conditional subliminal trait allegedly "factorizes into two dissociable early-layer directions" with "the SAME payload direction, once extracted, transfers across different triggers," while payload dormancy explains greater repair resistance. Searches using "conditional subliminal learning trigger payload direction," "trigger gated subliminal backdoor," "LLM backdoor trigger detector payload representation," and "persistent backdoor fine tuning" identify Towards Understanding Subliminal Learning (2025) as the closest mechanistic subliminal-learning work, DeepPayload (2021) as prior detector-plus-payload conditional logic, and Persistent Backdoor Attacks under Continual Fine-Tuning of LLMs (2025) as prior durability work; the submission’s cited Phantom Transfer (2026), which would be the closest setting match, could not be independently verified from the supplied search results. Moving from those works to a latent, separately manipulable, cross-trigger-invariant payload direction whose inactivity causes persistence requires a new core mechanistic relationship rather than merely transferring standard backdoor analysis to subliminal learning, although the broader detector-gates-payload framing and stealth/persistence themes are established, supporting high but not paradigm-level novelty.
